## [RELATED ISSUES]

Link every issue this PR closes or relates to. Use "Closes #X" so issues

-->
Closes #

## [WHAT]
<!--
What does this PR do, in plain words? One or two sentences.
-->

## [WHY]
<!--
Why is this change needed? Link back to the feature or problem it solves.
-->

## [HOW]
<!--
Brief summary of the approach: key decisions, patterns used, which layers

-->

## [CHECKLIST]
- [ ] Code builds without warnings
- [ ] New/changed logic covered by tests where relevant
- [ ] Acceptance criteria of related issues met
- [ ] No secrets or connection strings committed
- [ ] Tested locally (incl. the affected UI flow, if applicable)

## [SCREENSHOT / DEMO]

Optional. For UI changes: a short screen recording or screenshot of the
